# Pitex 1.0.6

This release makes find matches readable on macOS and Ubuntu, and updates the
bundled Pi assistant to Pi 1.4.0.

## Changes

- Find matches on macOS and Ubuntu are now a subtle translucent wash behind
  the text instead of an opaque box drawn over it, so the matched text and
  its syntax colors stay readable in light and dark themes.
- The current match uses the same color at a higher opacity, so it still
  stands out from the other matches.
- Installing the Pi assistant on macOS, Ubuntu and Windows now installs
  Pi 1.4.0 (previously 1.0.2) with its matching pi-codemode 1.4.0
  dependency.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 through 1.0.5 update to 1.0.6 from Settings or, with automatic
installation enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run
`brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.0.6
from the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate
update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and
SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
